PDF engine for SHEM/SHIMI documents: mpdf/mpdf v8.3.1 (GPL-2.0-only) + its dependencies, as installed by composer from SHEM-DOK/plugin/composer.lock.
Trimmed for the repo (runtime unchanged): removed nested .git folders, tests, utils, docs, phpstan/phpunit files, and all fonts except DejaVu* and GNUFree* (the code uses dejavusans).
Verified 31.10.2026: same Hebrew test document rendered with the full and the trimmed vendor gives identical size (69953 bytes), identical text and identical embedded fonts.
